headline: Nvidia employees petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
body: Nvidia employees have launched a petition calling for Jensen Huang's return as CEO, following his departure amid reports of workplace conduct issues. The move signals internal friction at the company that dominates GPU infrastructure for AI applications across healthcare systems. For healthcare AI practitioners, Nvidia's leadership stability directly impacts GPU availability, pricing, and roadmap priorities for clinical AI deployments, EHR integration tools, and inference infrastructure that hospitals depend on. Vendor landscape shifts at this scale typically create supply chain uncertainty and force health systems to reassess infrastructure partnerships. Monitor Nvidia's official response and leadership announcements closely if your organization relies on their hardware for AI workloads.
